title: Pawffee
summary: A digital home for recipes that almost did not survive: paper, index cards and handwritten notes, kept with technique notes, failures and honest verdicts.

problem: Recipes live on paper and index cards, and the notes that made them work (technique, what to check first) do not survive being retyped.
thinking: A recipe page should keep the notes next to the steps.
solution: Photo-first recipe pages with a “before you start” note, step-by-step photos, search, categories and a PDF download.
wake: Free-tier hosting: the first request after a period of inactivity may take 30–60s to wake the server back up.
built: Photo-first recipe pages with a “before you start” note and a photo for each step, searchable by name, ingredient or category.

fr.origin: La cuisine est l’un de mes passe-temps préférés, et Pawffee est le nom de mon coffee shop de rêve (paw + coffee). J’essaie beaucoup de recettes, puis je les perds. J’enregistre des photos, et je les perds aussi, et partager une recette en photographiant une page manuscrite moche et à moitié mouillée n’a rien de pratique. Je détestais avoir une pile de carnets et ne rien pouvoir retrouver. J’ai donc créé un endroit où ajouter mes recettes avec tous leurs détails et leurs photos, puis les trier et chercher ce que je veux.

origin: Cooking is one of my favourite hobbies, and Pawffee is my dream coffee shop name (paw + coffee). I try a lot of recipes and then lose them. I save photos and lose those too, and sharing a recipe by photographing an ugly, half-wet handwritten page is not convenient. I hated having a pile of notebooks and not being able to find anything. So I made a place where I can add my recipes with all their details and pictures, then sort and search for whatever I want.
